Class Polynomial<T extends RingElement<T>>

java.lang.Object
AbstractMath.Rings.Structures.Polynomial.Polynomial<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
RingElement<Polynomial<T>>
public final class Polynomial<T extends RingElement<T>> extends Object implements RingElement<Polynomial<T>>
An immutable polynomial whose coefficients belong to one ring. Index i stores the coefficient of x to the power i. Coefficient objects must provide value equality and must themselves be immutable. Arithmetic creates new polynomials without changing operands. Use a Builder to assign coefficients individually before creating a complete value. List construction and arithmetic results remove trailing zero coefficients. Every supplied coefficient must have the same nested type, including trailing zeros.

  • Constructor Details

    • Polynomial

      public Polynomial(List<T> coefficients)
      Infers the initial degree from the list, then copies and reduces its coefficients.
      Parameters:
      coefficients - a nonempty list ordered from constant to highest power
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the list is empty or coefficients have different nested types
      NullPointerException - if the list or any coefficient is null

    • Polynomial

      public Polynomial(int degree, List<T> coefficients)
      Copies exactly degree + 1 coefficients and removes trailing zeros. The supplied degree describes the input list before reduction. The resulting degree may be lower when leading coefficients are zero.
      Parameters:
      degree - the highest term degree represented in the input list
      coefficients - the coefficients in ascending degree order
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if degree is negative, does not match the list size, or coefficients have different nested types
      NullPointerException - if the list or any coefficient is null
